meta.analysis_provenance: Observed-panel Model A/B effects, support screens, and their 200 joint-refit intervals were carried from the earlier full run; they were not retrained in the final flat layout. Measured and follow-up tables were recomputed in the earlier flat-layout revision. Reviewer diagnostics and Figure 3a's spatial absolute-LST cross-validation were recomputed here; Figure 3b/c retain the saved A/B diagnostics. Figure 5 was replotted from the saved results. See RUN_PROVENANCE.md.
meta.decision_scope_note: Legacy decision-maker label was unused in estimation and reset to null for the optional allocation tool; numerical outputs are unchanged.
